entry.title: Updated: dsh-deepread
entry.summary: DeepRead: deep-reading assistant with five modes (quick / deep / knowledge map with four confidence levels / Feynman reading / whole book), batch comparison, budget preflight, and transparent background-job progress, from WeChat article links / local .pdf (built-in pure-JS extractor) / pasted text, with optional MD / FreeMind / styled HTML export. Exact install spec: github:xiehuan123/dsh-deepread. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: description, description_i18n.
